summary_en: 1.665–1.8M shares, ¥250/share, Aug 14–Sep 10, 2026. Offeror 桃の木 holds 1.84M shares (22.38% post-split). Tender will lift offeror stake to 42.63–44.27%. Board recommends tender; shareholders' choice neutral. Listing on TSE Standard market to be maintained post-closing.
title_en: Notice of Opinion Expression Regarding Public Tender Offer for CAPITA Inc. Shares by Momo no Ki Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: CAPITA Inc. disclosed on 13 August 2026 that its board has expressed support (with shareholder participation neutral) for a public tender offer by Momo no Ki Co., Ltd. Momo no Ki, which currently holds 1.84 million CAPITA shares (22.38% of post-split outstanding stock, ex-treasury), proposes to tender for 1.665–1.8 million additional shares at ¥250 per share during the period 14 August to 10 September 2026 (20 business days). The purchase would increase Momo no Ki's stake to 42.63–44.27% (calculated on both absolute share count and voting rights bases). The stated purpose is pure investment. Critically, the board has clarified that the offer does NOT intend to delist CAPITA shares; the company's listing on the TSE Standard market will be maintained after closing. The board's decision to recommend the tender while taking a neutral stance on shareholder participation reflects the transaction's structure: Momo no Ki is the principal shareholder and a related party, yet the post-closing ownership will remain below a majority, preserving public-market listing. No price ceiling above ¥250 is disclosed.
